_why: In an ambush a clumsy rogue (DEX 8) loses initiative, and the hedge-mage takes its turn first: the rogue's round 1 dagger attack has no Assassinate advantage (solo, so no Sneak Attack or bonus either). Refresh is off: the harness starts at fight_library with combat_enemy_advantage set once, fight_setup clears it, so a replay of the opening page runs as no ambush. In the game the calling scene sets it again on the same page, so this is a harness limit, not a game bug.
